title: Let the machines check the work
subtitle: Eleven saves on verifying what agents write, the skills that help, and where your own attention should go
editor_note: This week's saves keep landing on one question: if agents write the code, who checks it? Lee Knowlton sorts work by whether AI can verify it, Addy Osmani and the Claude Code team turn review into layered checks, and Lauren starts with the comments agents copy. Then come the tools, from Ben Holmes's pseudocode PR summaries to April's hand-inked figures, and the people side: Felix Rieseberg and Dan Koe on aiming higher, and swyx on the engineers everyone is hiring.
